title: On Responding to every letter within a week
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：respond　|　正文 370 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 respond 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the grower ① responded to every letter within a week for the whole place, and every buyer in the greenhouse said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three summers on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the grower ② responds to every letter within a week without a word of thanks without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ respond to every letter within a week at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ responded to every letter within a week before — a line in the ledger for August 1985 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Responding to every letter within a week for the whole place, the grower said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the crate at the far shelf, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ respond to the cold with new growth without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Respond to the cold with new growth at once and never mention it again.

By 1998 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new buyer from the next greenhouse ⑧ responds to the cold with new growth for the whole place every summer without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shelf, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ responded to every letter within a week again when nobody else would.

⑩ To respond to every letter within a week, my mother said in 2003, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the greenhouse remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the greenhouse forgets, somebody responds to every letter within a week without a word of thanks again and somebody must respond to every letter within a week for the whole place all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 回应（一般过去式 responded to every letter within a week：1991 年种植户头一回这样做，替所有人）
B. v. 回应（一般现在 responds to every letter within a week：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 回应（不定式 to respond to every letter within a week：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 回应（过去完成时 had responded to every letter within a week：1985 年八月的收成账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 回应（动名词 responding to every letter within a week 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 反应（respond to the cold with new growth：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去反应遇寒之后反倒抽出新芽）
G. v. 反应（respond to the cold with new growth：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 回应（后段两处：新来的收购人照例 responds to the cold with new growth，而母亲又一次 responded to every letter within a week）

answers.why: respond 意为“回应”，1991 年种植户替所有人回应一周之内回每一封信，那是大棚里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 responded。
respond 意为“回应”，自那以后种植户不图一句谢把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 responds。
respond 意为“回应”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯回应一周之内回每一封信”，此处为不定式 to respond to every letter within a week。
respond 意为“回应”，收成账里 八月 那行字说明早在 1998 年之前就有人回应过，故用过去完成时 had responded。
respond 意为“回应”，种植户说“回应一周之内回每一封信这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 responding to every letter within a week 作主语。
respond 意为“反应”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去反应遇寒之后反倒抽出新芽”，should ever 之后用原形 respond to the cold with new growth。
respond 意为“反应”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻反应遇寒之后反倒抽出新芽（respond to the cold with new growth at once），以后再也不要提起。
respond 意为“回应”，新来的收购人每个夏天都照例反应遇寒之后反倒抽出新芽，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 responds。
respond 意为“回应”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次替所有人回应一周之内回每一封信，用一般过去式 responded 叙述。
respond 意为“回应”，结尾那句是母亲 2003 年的话：要回应一周之内回每一封信，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和大棚记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 respond 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1991 the grower responded to every letter within a week for the whole place, and nobody in the greenhouse forgot it.
Even now the grower responds to every letter within a week without a word of thanks whenever the greenhouse asks.
Responding to every letter within a week for the whole place, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever respond to the cold with new growth without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new buyer from the next greenhouse responds to the cold with new growth for the whole place every summer, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother responded to every letter within a week again, and the greenhouse remembered that half.
